subject.title: fix(agents): preserve runtime tool inheritance tokens

question: After conflict resolution, should OpenClaw preserve policy-filtered deferred MCP/LSP selector tokens in spawned child inherited allowlists?
rationale: This is a child-session tool authorization boundary, and the current branch conflicts with newer policy code that maintainers need to reconcile intentionally.

options.title: Refresh And Owner-Review
options.body: Resolve conflicts on current main and have an agent/gateway owner verify that preserved selectors are filtered through the same effective policy intersection as materialized tools.

options.title: Replace At Runtime Boundary
options.body: If maintainers prefer not to persist selector tokens in session state, replace this with an owner-authored fix closer to runtime materialization.

options.title: Pause For Broader Subagent Policy
options.body: Pause this branch only if a broader maintained subagent tool-policy PR becomes the canonical safe landing path for the same bug.

recommendation.title: Refresh And Owner-Review
recommendation.body: Resolve conflicts on current main and have an agent/gateway owner verify that preserved selectors are filtered through the same effective policy intersection as materialized tools.
